name: Name
studyWords: Take a moment to remember these words.
tapSameOrder: Tap the numbers in the same order
adaptiveDifficultySub: Two scores of 80% or more in a row move you up one level. Two scores of 50% or less gently lower the level.
signInSub: Continue as a patient or caregiver with the same secure login.
resetLinkSent: Password reset link sent. Please check your email.
patientSignupTitle: Tell us a little about you
patientSignupSub: Create one private family space. MemoryCare will generate your invite code once, which you can share with up to four caregivers.
caregiverSignupIntro: Care feels closer when everyone stays connected.
caregiverSignupSub: Use the patient's invite code to join their private care space, add memories and reminders, and follow cognitive progress.
spaceReadySub: Share this code only with family members or caregivers you trust.
inviteShareNote: This code is generated once for the patient group and can link up to 4 caregivers.
connectedSub: You are now connected to the patient care space.
errInvalidCredential: Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.
errUserDisabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact support.
errTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errNetwork: Network problem. Please check your internet connection.
errEmailInUse: An account already exists with this email address.
errWeakPassword: Please use a password with at least 6 characters.
errInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errInvalidInviteCode: That invite code is not valid. Please check with the patient.
errGroupFull: This care space already has four caregivers.
errMissingFields: Please fill in all the required fields.
errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errResetEmpty: Please type your email address first, then tap Forgot password.
profileMissingTitle: We could not find your saved profile
profileMissingBody: Your login worked, but the MemoryCare profile for this account is missing or could not be read. This usually means the account was created but the profile step did not finish.
profileMissingPatientHint: If you are a patient, create your care space again with the same email.
profileMissingCaregiverHint: If you are a caregiver, ask the patient for the invite code and join again.
removedTitle: You are no longer in this care space
removedBody: Either the patient removed your caregiver access, or you left the care space yourself. Your MemoryCare account still works — you can rejoin with the invite code if this was a mistake.
welcomePatient: Good to see you. What would you like to do?
brainGamesSub: Five gentle activities for your mind
welcomeSub: Small moments, familiar memories and gentle practice — all in one calm place.
familyIntro: Everyone who can see and support this care space.
inviteCodeHelp: Share this code with a family member so they can join as a caregiver.
noCaregivers: No caregivers linked yet. Share the invite code above with a family member.
removeBody: {{name}} will immediately lose access to this care space — reminders, memories, game progress and pager data. Their MemoryCare account stays active, and they can rejoin later with the invite code.
leaveBody: You will lose access to this patient's reminders, memories and progress. You can rejoin later with the invite code.
leftSpaceMsg: You have left this care space.
galleryIntro: Familiar people, places and celebrations can help start warm conversations.
addMemorySub: Create a familiar moment for the patient.
photoTooLarge: Photo is too large. Please choose a smaller image.
noMemories: No memories have been added yet. A family member can add them from the caregiver dashboard.
deleteMemoryBody: The photo and its story will be removed for everyone.
rememberQuestion: Do you remember this moment or these people?
takeYourTime: Take your time and enjoy the memory.
memoryGameSub: Match the North East inspired symbols
memoryInstruction: Match the North East inspired symbols.
attentionInstruction: Tap the picture that is different.
routineInstruction: Tap the steps in the correct order.
numberInstruction: Remember the numbers, then tap them in the same order.
pairFound: Well done. You found a pair.
tryAgainGentle: Nice try. Take your time and try again.
lookAgain: Good try. Look gently once more.
routineRetry: Nice effort. Review the correct sequence and try again later.
levelUpNote: Two in a row at 80% or more raises the level. Two at 50% or less lowers it.
dashboardSub: Progress, memories and daily care — organised in one reassuring dashboard.
pagerManagementSub: Enter and sync separate offline information to the patient's ESP32 pager.
performanceInsightsSub: Activity trends only — not a medical diagnosis.
notMedicalAdvice: Activity trends only — not a medical diagnosis.
scheduledByFamily: Your family can schedule reminders for you.
snoozed: Okay. We will remind you again in 10 minutes.
scheduleReminderSub: It will appear automatically for the patient.
pickFutureTime: Please choose a date and time in the future.
pagerIntro: Enter only the information you want stored on the patient's pager. This section is completely separate from app reminders, family and profile data.
pagerPreviewNote: This preview represents the simple menu the patient will navigate using UP, DOWN and SELECT.
pagerSaved: Pager information saved. Connect and sync when the device is nearby.
pagerSyncOk: Pager updated successfully. Old device data was replaced and the new data is saved offline on the pager.
pagerSyncFail: Sync failed. Keep the pager nearby, then try again.
pagerSyncNoAck: Data was sent, but the pager did not confirm it. If the screen did not change, keep the pager close and try again.
pagerClearedDevice: Physical pager cleared. Your saved Pager Management data is still available in MemoryCare.
pagerClearedAll: All Pager Management data and physical pager data were cleared.
pagerClearedAllOffline: Pager Management data cleared. Connect the physical pager later and use Clear Device if it still contains old offline data.
pagerDangerSub: Clear only the physical device, or remove all Pager Management information and start again.
pagerConfirmDeviceBody: This erases the offline information stored on the ESP32 but keeps your saved MemoryCare Pager Management data.
pagerConfirmAllBody: This removes Personal Info, Routine, Medicines, Contacts and Emergency information saved in Pager Management.
pagerConfirmAllOffline: The physical pager is not connected, so its offline copy cannot be erased right now.
pagerSeparateBody: Nothing here is automatically copied from MemoryCare's normal reminders, family or patient profile.
pagerDiagnosticsHint: Use this panel when the pager connects but data does not arrive. It shows exactly which Bluetooth service was found and what was sent.
pagerNoWritable: No writable Bluetooth characteristic was found on this device.
pagerBrowserUnsupported: This browser cannot talk to Bluetooth devices
pagerBrowserUnsupportedBody: Use Chrome or Edge on a laptop or Android phone. On iPhone/iPad, Web Bluetooth is not supported by Safari at all. You can still use USB cable sync on a laptop.
pagerShowAllDevicesHint: Turn this on if your pager does not appear in the list. It also helps when you flashed your own ESP32 sketch.
pagerNoMessages: No messages from the pager yet.
pagerEmptyData: Add at least a patient name or one routine item before syncing.
pagerUsbUnsupported: USB cable sync needs Chrome or Edge on a laptop, and the ESP32 plugged in.
pagerUsbHint: USB is a reliable backup when Bluetooth is blocked.
pagerDisconnectedMsg: Pager disconnected. Saved pager data is still available.
pagerNoGroup: No patient group is linked to this caregiver yet.
pagerLoadFailed: Could not load saved pager data. You can still enter pager information below.
pagerStep1: 1. Fill in the information you want on the pager.
pagerStep2: 2. Tap Connect Pager and choose your ESP32 pager from the Bluetooth list.
pagerStep3: 3. Tap Sync / Replace Pager Data and wait for the confirmation message.
pagerStep4: 4. The pager keeps working offline — no internet needed on the device.
pagerProtocolLine: Protocol: MCV1 text lines over Bluetooth LE (or USB serial).
levelUp: Two strong games in a row — level increased!
levelDown: Difficulty gently reduced for next time.
rememberNumbers: Remember {{count}} numbers in the same order.
errConfig: This app is not connected to a Firebase project yet. Add your Firebase keys to the .env file (see .env.example).
